name: 深度数据诊断探针
purpose: Run bounded deterministic contrasts for pre/post comparison, subgroup heterogeneity, and future-safe rolling-origin prediction so semantic explanations can be confronted with measured differences.
eligibility_checks: the analysis unit, outcome, time window, and group definitions are explicit
required cells or rolling history contain usable numeric observations
the result will be interpreted within the declared design rather than by method name
an adoption-grade execution uses a hashed file input and explicit data evidence references
assumptions: difference-in-differences is only a contrast until parallel trends and other identifying assumptions are supported
subgroup differences are descriptive heterogeneity candidates unless treatment effects are identified
rolling-origin predictions use no observation after the prediction origin
human_gates: review causal assumptions before interpreting a quasi-experimental contrast as an intervention effect
outputs: difference-in-differences contrast and four cell counts
subgroup-specific contrasts, effect spread, and opposite-direction flag
rolling-origin naive MAE with origin-target prediction records
rejection of overlapping pre/post periods and duplicate timestamps in a single-series forecast
explicit claim boundary for each probe
execution bindings for outcome field, forecast semantics, and treatment/control group mapping
diagnostics: future-leakage protection recorded per rolling origin
invalid pre/post ordering or mixed series at the same timestamp
evidence_requirements: group and period definitions when applicable
allowed_claims: the declared pre/post group contrast has a measured value
the observed group difference varies across declared subgroups
the naive forecast has the reported out-of-sample error over the tested origins
forbidden_claims: a difference-in-differences calculation alone proves causality
subgroup contrast proves individualized treatment effect
in-sample fit or randomly shuffled time rows prove forecast performance
one successful probe validates a full mechanism
